segments.title: meditation in limitless space

spans.tib: nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched

spans.nul: Plurality is fused into beings in pleasure beings; no separate English plural word.

Nam mkhar is retained with its case ending, aligned lexically to empty space; as remains in the English frame.
